phases.title: Reconcile the actual baseline and upstream inventory
phases.scope: Read-only inventory and bounded execution setup.
steps: Read AGENTS, FAST_EXECUTION, current PROGRESS, DELIVERY_WORKFLOW, this plan, EE/MEX evidence and actual changes. Record tested source, deployed source and device obligations separately.

Use maintained dev synchronized normally from main. If occupied, use a managed isolated worktree and coordinate its eventual integration; never stash, reset or overwrite another task. Reconcile stable task IDs before creating trackers.

Inventory every relevant CoMaps capability at a pinned upstream SHA, actual native/build entry points, package format, notices and third-party dependencies. Document kept, adapted and excluded capabilities. Do not assume an Android SDK exists.
checks: Verify inventory against real code, not just an old checklist.
Record actual SQL and Room versions; never allocate migration numbers from this plan.
phases.exit: A scoped source/feature/dependency inventory identifies the next task and source revisions.
phases.commit: docs(maps): reconcile the actual baseline and upstream inventory

phases.title: Freeze behavior, source rights and commercial admission
phases.scope: Contracts only; no UI and no source activation.
steps: Write B-BR-MAP and BUC-MAP cases from the mandatory rules below. Freeze price-source switching, marker eligibility, offline expiry, permissions and navigation behavior.

Complete the source register: exact bytes/revision, code/data/artwork licenses, commercial use, offline redistribution, attribution, derived-database obligations and access terms. Unknown rights means not admitted.

Record an ADR for the CoMaps-derived native engine and its isolation. Native C++/JNI is a declared exception to the Rust preparer language, not a backend rewrite. An alternative engine requires an explicit revised plan; never silently substitute MapLibre or a WebView.
checks: Contract fixtures cover ANP-only, community-only, unknown prices, combined sites and missing coordinates.
Review transitive CoMaps licenses and upstream service endpoints independently from Apache-2.0 core.
phases.exit: Behavior and admission rules are versioned; no required input is silently unlicensed.
phases.commit: docs(maps): freeze behavior, source rights and commercial admission

phases.title: Close the existing electric runtime gaps
phases.scope: Reuse EE/MEX components; repair composition and incomplete selectors.
steps: Reproduce actual missing charging command, owner, history and rank handlers with process-level tests, then register existing components using narrow ports and original feature gates.
Reproduce private charge read/delete failures; complete dataset selectors without changing refuel/expense behavior, ownership or idempotency.
Reconcile EE-22/24/25/26-31 obligations. Reuse passing implementation and name outstanding source, scenario, backup and physical proofs; do not restart the old plan or claim full EV acceptance.
checks: Actual Go API process + disposable PostGIS: signed writes, owner read/delete, foreign owner, replay, disabled gate and failures.
Affected Go race suites, SQL/migration tests immediately if changed; Kotlin wire regressions if affected.
phases.exit: Current basic electric routes work on the local real API; preserved gaps have explicit owners and dependencies.
phases.commit: feat(maps): close the existing electric runtime gaps

phases.title: Define map artifacts and cross-language contracts
phases.scope: Versioned schemas and fixtures before producers/consumers.
steps: Define map POI, assertion provenance, station/charging aliases, exact price observations, geometry quality, clocks and capability flags. Reuse existing UUID and EV types.

Define a map prepared envelope compatible with the existing manifest/hash/census discipline; reuse charging-prepared-v1 where applicable. Separate OSM-derived reference packages, public first-party observations and private state.

Define native-map manifest fields: engine/upstream SHA, generator SHA, format/data generation, regions/neighbors, bytes/digests, source rights and attribution. Placeholder field names become frozen only with schema tests.
checks: Rust/Go/Kotlin goldens for bytes, units, IDs, unknowns and schema rejection.
Reject overflow, duplicate keys, wrong hash, wrong rights/profile, truncated streams and unsupported versions.
phases.exit: A real golden corpus can be consumed without ambiguous units or fabricated coordinates/prices.
phases.commit: docs(maps): define map artifacts and cross-language contracts

phases.title: Prepare OSM reference and location candidates in Rust
phases.scope: Regional OSM data, fuel/charging POIs and access candidates.
steps: Use a rights-admitted pinned regional PBF/extract from OSM/Geofabrik; fetching stays in the Go acquisition boundary. Rust parses local bounded files without network or DB.

Extract nodes/ways/relations for fuel and charging with names, addresses, source IDs, connectors, access, hours and geometry provenance. Preserve unknown tags and distinguish equipment from site; do not trust arbitrary tags as live state.

Emit deterministic entities, decisions, aliases and full census. Missing coordinates remain missing; a city centroid is never a station entrance. Validate coordinate ranges and country/region consistency without deleting legitimate border cases.
checks: Streaming limit and malformed PBF/tag tests, Unicode, duplicate IDs, nested children and cancellation/old-output preservation.
Known synthetic node/way/relation fixtures and actual regional sample qualification outside Git.
phases.exit: Every input unit is accounted for; the last good output survives failure; OSM licensing accompanies the artifact.
phases.commit: feat(maps): prepare osm reference and location candidates in rust

phases.title: Prepare exact per-station ANP price facts in Rust
phases.scope: Extend price ingestion without replacing the existing Android ANP importer.
steps: Inspect current CSV/XLSX and local import contracts first. Add the missing server-side preparer only where necessary; never assume prepare_prices exists.

Normalize actual station-level survey facts with observed date, publication/survey period, product, sale price, unit, CNPJ/address identity and source reference. Reuse product taxonomy and exact decimal rules.
Keep city/state aggregates separate. Quarantine ambiguous station links and unsupported units; never attach municipal mean to a station or manufacture an ANP premium/electric price.
checks: Brazilian decimal/date/encoding/leading-zero CNPJ fixtures, duplicate/correction/out-of-order survey rows and exact unit tests.
Cross-language comparison with the current Android importer; existing historical price behavior remains valid.
phases.exit: ANP station facts have a traceable source and deterministic identity; unchanged current import behavior is proven.
phases.commit: feat(maps): prepare exact per-station anp price facts in rust

phases.title: Prepare admitted charging and vehicle reference data
phases.scope: Reuse electric producers and admit only open commercial-use subsets.
steps: Reuse prepare_charging, ev_ocm and trusted profiles; select only individually admitted providers/records, including redistribution and attribution. opendata flags alone do not bypass the rights manifest.

Normalize place/equipment/connector, declared power, access and independent status clocks. Unknown tariff or status is not free or available. Do not transform OCM comments/photos into automatically reusable Abastevo content.

Reuse prepare_vehicle only for admitted reference inputs. PBE/manufacturer data remain optional until rights/variant matching are established; manual useful capacity/consumption enables core travel without proprietary catalogs.
checks: Existing EV preparation suites plus mixed-rights, unknown connector, missing power, child census and exact tariff-unit cases.
No contributor PII, precise contributor GPS or photos in public artifacts.
phases.exit: An admitted regional charging batch can be produced with unknowns intact; optional blocked catalogs do not falsify readiness.
phases.commit: feat(maps): prepare admitted charging and vehicle reference data

phases.title: Resolve identities, co-located services and navigation entrances
phases.scope: Explicit reconciliation instead of distance-only merges.
steps: Keep Directory station UUIDs and charging identities; add aliases/relationships with source, method and reversible review state. Preserve alphanumeric CNPJ and leading zeros.
Use CNPJ/address/network/geometry as evidence, not automatic proof. Nearby competing stations or multiple chargers in a shopping center must stay distinct.
Distinguish display point from road-access entrance and location quality. A combined establishment can expose both fuel and charging without duplicate selectable prices or fictional co-location.
checks: Near-neighbor false merge, CNPJ change, franchise, address ambiguity, stale correction and split/unlink tests.
Real PostGIS concurrent reconciliation/review/rollback tests when storage is added.
phases.exit: No unsafe identity/price/location conflation; reviewed and unresolved relationships remain distinguishable.
phases.commit: feat(maps): resolve identities, co-located services and navigation entrances

phases.title: Build the native map-generation toolchain
phases.scope: CoMaps-compatible map assets; no Android UI yet.
steps: Pin the actual CoMaps map generator/toolchain/submodules and admitted source data. Verify actual CLI and required world/regional/search/routing/style resources before writing wrappers.

Run the native generator as a versioned build-time tool alongside the Rust-prepared POI stream; do not reimplement its map format in Rust. Go orchestrates acquisition, bounded tool execution and publication.

Produce a consistent regional map set with routing/search and neighbor/overview dependencies. Separate immutable map packages from frequently updated Abastevo prices; no full national build on the shared VPS by default.
checks: A clean reproducible tool build and regional generation; verify format and dependency manifest against pinned engine documentation.
Corrupt/truncated input, process timeout, traversal, resource exhaustion and atomic previous-generation preservation.
phases.exit: A self-produced, rights-admitted regional package set exists with exact generator/data hashes and required dependencies.
paths: scripts/ (build-time commands after verifying upstream CLI)
phases.commit: feat(maps): build the native map-generation toolchain

phases.title: Import and publish map assertions transactionally in Go
phases.scope: Prepared artifacts to existing PostgreSQL/PostGIS modules.
steps: Extend existing acquisition/native bridge and publication patterns. Validate all hashes/profiles/census before publishing and keep raw/public/private storage boundaries.
Stage assertions and aliases; publish one consistent generation atomically. Use existing module ports and jobs; no speculative microservice or second canonical station table.
Allocate append-only migrations from actual HEAD; include source/rights references, geometry indexes and recovery. Support safe replay, cancellation and old-reader compatibility.
checks: Mandatory real PostGIS empty install, previous-schema upgrade, replay, two writers, cancelled import, rollback and crash recovery.
Go race + parameterized SQL/static/sqlc checks; unauthorized/malformed prepared input refused.
phases.exit: Failed ingestion cannot partially replace the public catalog or lose existing station/user data.
paths: backend/db/migrations/ (next version verified from actual HEAD)
phases.commit: feat(maps): import and publish map assertions transactionally in go

phases.title: Serve bounded spatial discovery and exact price projections
phases.scope: Viewport/nearby/corridor and quick-detail API contracts.
steps: Extend current Directory and charging APIs through contracts; add missing bounded spatial endpoints only after checking reuse. Query by viewport/zoom or route corridor with appropriate GiST indexes and stable ordering.

Expose marker type, location quality, source-separated selected-fuel prices, time/period, known/unknown state and attribution. Apply query/response/area limits, bounded pagination or server aggregation; never return all Brazil.

Bind cursor/cache identity to area, source mode, product, survey period, filters, generation and permissions. Batch price loading; no per-pin N+1. Public reads remain anonymous; writes/owner reads stay signed.
checks: PostGIS actual query plans/load fixtures, antimeridian/invalid bbox, huge corridor, pagination tamper, stale generation and timeout/cancellation.
Price-source, product/unit/condition isolation and stale response generation tests.
phases.exit: A bounded API returns honest individual prices and enough metadata for map selection without leaking private data.
phases.commit: feat(maps): serve bounded spatial discovery and exact price projections

phases.title: Apply freshness, moderation and source lifecycle rules
phases.scope: Different lifetimes for geometry, price and operational observations.
steps: Reuse existing refresh/consensus/moderation contracts. Add operational events only through new explicit rules; no invented fixed expiry or confidence percentage.
Keep observed_at, published_at, fetched_at and source generation distinct. Revocations/corrections/deletions propagate through snapshots and tombstones without rewriting history.

OCM/OSM static status, community reports and authorized dynamic data remain separate; the open-only launch has no assumed operator live feed. Kill switches and rollback retain the last admitted generation.
checks: Clock-boundary and malformed/future date cases; stale/withdrawn/retracted values and mixed-generation negative tests.
Concurrent reports, moderation removal, cursor/cache invalidation and signed owner operations on real PostGIS.
phases.exit: A static/cached point never becomes a fictional live availability or fresh price.
phases.commit: feat(maps): apply freshness, moderation and source lifecycle rules

phases.title: Publish regional manifests and recoverable download contracts
phases.scope: Public open data distribution with explicit access/integrity rules.
steps: Expose versioned regional manifests and public immutable packages through existing Go/Compose/Caddy boundaries, separate from private S3 media. Do not make the private media bucket public.

Use HTTPS, verified digests and authenticated manifest integrity (signed metadata with app-pinned verification key), fixed allowed origins/path IDs, size limits, resumable Range/ETag semantics and key rotation.

Advertise engine-format compatibility and complete dependency sets. Stage files, verify all, atomically activate; retain rollback and reclaim policy. Open-license source/derived-database offers remain accessible as required.
checks: Manifest/signature tamper, bad digest, changed ETag/range, disk full, cancelled transfer, missing neighbor/world files and old app compatibility.
HTTP actual-process tests, invalid path/redirect/SSRF controls and recovery to last valid package.
phases.exit: Downloads have a testable integrity and recovery protocol; public map delivery cannot expose private objects.
phases.commit: feat(maps): publish regional manifests and recoverable download contracts

phases.title: Prove the data pipeline before Android map work
phases.scope: Hard DATA_GATE with real prepared bytes, process and local client decoding.
steps: Execute admitted local input -> actual Rust executable/native generator -> real Go import/PostGIS -> running HTTP API -> Kotlin decoder fixture/Room import contract. No fake HTTP response may stand in for the real Go output.
Cover one fuel station with per-station ANP price, community-only station, charging site, combined site, no-price point, unknown/missing location, disputed identity and blocked-license record.
Record source/rights/preparer/generator/schema/API bytes and generation. Physical Android interaction is later; exact Kotlin decoding and local DB behavior must pass now.
checks: End-to-end all named fixtures with exact IDs/prices/units and rejected inputs; real source process failures and old-generation survival.
Rust/Go/Kotlin contract checks and SQLite migration tests; required tests must execute rather than skip.
phases.exit: DATA_GATE PASS: data is consumable and legally admitted before adding the map tab.
phases.commit: feat(maps): prove the data pipeline before android map work

phases.title: Extract, package and own the pinned CoMaps-derived engine
phases.scope: Committed extraction: pinned/audited native core, Abastevo-owned reproducible AAR and narrow MapEngine port. ENGINE_GATE proves it before UI.
steps: T01 pin/vendor only the minimal CoMaps core/JNI host and required submodules at an exact SHA; pin NDK/CMake/Qt-skin/generator; preserve licenses, mark patches, draft SBOM and build twice reproducibly.

T02 freeze the Kotlin MapEngine port and ownership boundary: Kotlin owns lifecycle/FileProvider/storage/permissions/location/threading, native owns render/map reader/search/routing, no native types in domain/data.

T03 build the owned AAR/module with release arm64-v8a and supported armeabi-v7a, debug-only x86_64, minSdk 26, 16 KB pages, stripped symbols, no Qt runtime; integrate without replacing app roots and record size/build/RAM/disk budgets.

T04 implement initialization, resources, storage, FileProvider, location callback and lifecycle/rotation/process-death teardown behind the port; test double init, corrupt/missing packages, denied permission and stale callbacks.
T05 load an admitted regional package set and prove Abastevo-owned light/dark render, pan/zoom/recenter, OSM attribution, offline search and one offline car route using roads/entrances/restrictions.

T06 prove the Abastevo overlay fixture with canonical UUIDs and location quality, hit-testing without proximity merge, independent overlay generations, co-located fuel/charging, clustering, 48dp targets and accessible list equivalence.
T07 complete transitive license/ODbL audit, SBOM/notices, secret/endpoint scan, offline redistribution evidence and documented patch reapplication/rollback for engine updates.

T08 close ENGINE_GATE with real device/emulator render/select/search/route, JNI/ABI/lifecycle tests, measured budgets and MAP-14 evidence. On failure, stop dependent UI and record a bounded extraction revision; an alternative engine requires a new ADR.
checks: Clean reproducible owned artifact/AAR; per-ABI, minSdk 26 and 16 KB page-size proof; no CoMaps app, branding, CDN or service key.
Real native render/search/route and Abastevo overlay selection on owned emulator/device when authorized, plus JNI/ABI/lifecycle tests.
No missing native libs, no private upstream service/key assumption, no leaked activity/location callback.
Transitive licenses/SBOM/notices, ODbL attribution decision, measured APK/RAM/disk/build budgets and update/rollback recipe.
phases.exit: ENGINE_GATE PASS: an Abastevo-owned, reproducible, licensed CoMaps-derived engine artifact and adapter render, search, route and select Abastevo stations offline within measured budgets.
paths: third_party/comaps/ or bounded engine module (name frozen at T02)
phases.commit: feat(maps): extract and package the pinned comaps engine

phases.title: Add Android public map persistence and download recovery
phases.scope: Room/managed file storage; no map UI until verified import.
steps: Persist public map overlay generations, metadata, attribution and download progress using current DB conventions. Store map binaries outside Room; keep a separate private account namespace for routes/favorites.
Implement resumable cancel/retry downloads from MAP-12, signature/digest checks, dependency-aware activation, disk budget/quota warnings and safe deletion excluding active files.
Import public snapshots atomically; preserve old packages on failure. Reuse existing refresh/WorkManager policy instead of inventing aggressive periodic jobs or requiring login for public maps.
checks: Real SQLite old-schema upgrade/rollback behavior, corruption, process death, partial writes, disk full and simultaneous readers.
WorkManager retry/cancel/account switch and signed-manifest/key rotation tests.
phases.exit: An interrupted download/import cannot corrupt the last working public map or reveal account-private state.
phases.commit: feat(maps): add android public map persistence and download recovery

phases.title: Integrate the engine with Compose lifecycle and location
phases.scope: Map host and privacy-controlled platform services.
steps: Wrap the proven native surface in Compose using verified lifecycle hooks; own resource creation/disposal, pause/resume, configuration change and process recovery. Keep domain/data independent of native SDK types.

Use Android platform location, foreground permission and approximate-location behavior; browsing/search/manual city selection work without permission or GPS. No new Play Services dependency or background location for simple browsing.
Implement compass/recenter and map camera persistence separately from navigation stack. Cancel obsolete requests by generation; never paint a late source/filter response into a new selection.
checks: Lifecycle attach/detach/rotation/leak cases; no permission, approximate location, denied forever, GPS off and stale fix.
Deterministic view-model cancellation tests and native surface behavior evidence.
phases.exit: The map host works with existing app lifecycle, permissions and themes without continuous hidden GPS.
phases.commit: feat(maps): integrate the engine with compose lifecycle and location

phases.title: Add the fourth bottom tab and minimal map shell
phases.scope: Exact requested navigation order and existing UI language.
steps: Add Mapa between Comunidade and Perfil: Explorar | Comunidade | Mapa | Perfil. Use the existing bottom-bar icon system, localized label, equal-width cells and permanent visible labels.

Add a native MAP route/base following navigateToTabBase: single top, no restoration of a hidden child stack. Preserve station deep links and associate details opened from the map with the correct tab/origin.

Minimal shell contains the map, ANP/Comunidade selector at the top, fuel/charging filter entry, recenter, search and existing download affordance. Use the Abastevo-owned map style (brand, typography, light/dark, visible OSM attribution), not CoMaps branding or its app chrome. Honor safe areas, app light/dark/dynamic themes and shared container borders; no app-wide redesign.
checks: Actual navigation-controller regressions: four tabs/order, repeat tap, back, deep link, return from details and map child routes.
Compose semantics/48dp targets/200% font/narrow screen; affected app JVM, lint and debug assembly.
phases.exit: Four tabs work, and the real map is reachable without disrupting existing Explore/Community/Profile behavior.
phases.commit: feat(maps): add the fourth bottom tab and minimal map shell

phases.title: Render fuel and electric markers with clustering and selection
phases.scope: Use the supplied generated pictograms; do not overload the map.
steps: Integrate map-icons raw/provenance/SVG/Android exports through the current asset pipeline. Marker backing/selection is Abastevo-owned and uses theme-aware neutral contrast, not hardcoded white on all maps; reference OSM POIs stay visually distinct from Abastevo stations.

Render fuel pump and electric bolt/plug as distinct symbols. Co-located services expose both without overlapping duplicate pins. Show selected-product price only when compatible and known; cluster density deterministically.

Preserve stable marker IDs across source changes. Fetch bounded viewports, debounce moves, expand clusters and reconcile selection after generation replacement; never place unknown/city-centroid stations as exact pins.
checks: 20/24/48/128px light/dark basemap inspection; generated alpha/ink/provenance and silhouette checks.
Dense synthetic viewport, overlapping sites, repeated pan/source switch, hit targets, TalkBack equivalent list and unknown geometry cases.
phases.exit: Users can distinguish, select and reach a real station without depending only on marker color.
phases.commit: feat(maps): render fuel and electric markers with clustering and selection

phases.title: Show fast station prices and honest source switching
phases.scope: Map-to-bottom-sheet-to-existing-profile journey.
steps: On marker tap show name, service type, selected source, exact product/unit prices, survey/report date, access/location quality and actions to route/open full profile/report price.

ANP mode shows station-specific ANP observations for the chosen existing survey period; if absent, say no ANP price for this station. Community mode uses the current validated community projection with its date/conditions. No silent fallback/mixing.

Charging markers remain discoverable in ANP mode but state ANP does not supply an electric tariff. Offer explicit switch to Comunidade; never disable the source selector silently. No-price stations remain visible. Reuse existing vehicle/product/week selection semantics after defining persistence scope.
checks: Racing ANP/community responses, missing price, stale period, wrong fuel/unit, premium-vs-additive and EV-in-ANP tests.
Real quick sheet/profile route and data contract; no N+1 request fan-out.
phases.exit: Tap -> truthful quick prices -> existing profile/route works under both selected sources.
phases.commit: feat(maps): show fast station prices and honest source switching

phases.title: Complete discovery, accessibility and the minimal release gate
phases.scope: Search/filter/list equivalents before advanced navigation.
steps: Support current area, city and name/address search, fuel types, compatible connector, AC/DC, known power, access/hours and date. Unknown metadata is shown and is not automatically excluded.

Provide equivalent accessible list of visible results, readable sheet order, focus return, map-control descriptions, app-owned dark/light styles and no permission lockout. Store public last map position locally without precise-coordinate telemetry.

Prove the minimum product end to end: open Mapa -> choose source/fuel -> see compatible pins -> quick price -> profile -> route action. A user-chosen installed open-source navigator can be an explicit optional interim action, never claimed as completed native navigation.
checks: Native/device or user manual checklist with source dates, offline cached overlay, no GPS and 200% text.
Full affected navigation/UI/static tests and actual server->Kotlin price decode.
phases.exit: MINIMUM_MAP_GATE PASS with real map/prices; advanced navigation may remain planned, not hidden as completed.
phases.commit: feat(maps): complete discovery, accessibility and the minimal release gate

phases.title: Complete electric community and operational reports
phases.scope: Signed contributions with offline recovery and honest recency.
steps: Complete existing electric price/experience/edit/withdraw/vote/report screens by reuse. Add structured operational events per MAP-01, scoped to actual site/equipment/connector.

Reuse account proof, outbox, moderation, anti-abuse and ownership. Recover uploads after process death/network loss; contribution remains free. Do not activate photo intake or collection gates to add status reporting.
Separate static reference, dated community working reports and unavailable live feed. Show conditions and independent observations without invented scores or paid trust.
checks: Go process/PostGIS + Kotlin outbox replay, duplicate/reordered edits, withdrawn/rejected reports, foreign owner and concurrent moderation.
Account switch/logout, airplane recovery and timestamp boundary cases.
phases.exit: A real authorized user can submit/recover/edit/withdraw a report and see the correct public projection.
phases.commit: feat(maps): complete electric community and operational reports

phases.title: Implement offline route planning and search with the native core
phases.scope: Driving routes, stops and road constraints.
steps: Expose the verified core search/route APIs through the adapter. Resolve origin/destination by manual input, map point, current fix or saved POI; support intermediate stops and route preview.
Use road access/one-way/turn restrictions and permitted avoidance options proven upstream. Compare only routes actually returned; do not invent alternative paths or real-time traffic.

Require all regional/neighbor routing dependencies. If missing, offer the explicit package download; no straight-line route presented as drivable. Include station entrance rather than inaccessible centroid.
checks: Offline cross-region/neighbor, no route, inaccessible entrance, one-way/divided road, origin=destination and intermediate stops.
Native route cancellation/lifecycle and route-option contract cases with deterministic regional fixtures.
phases.exit: A real offline driving route can be planned, changed and cancelled with explicit missing-map states.
phases.commit: feat(maps): implement offline route planning and search with the native core

phases.title: Implement foreground navigation, rerouting and voice
phases.scope: Real guided navigation with explicit start/stop and privacy.
steps: Add maneuver/ETA/distance display, route progress, off-route recalculation and recoverable guidance state using the proven core. Time estimates are estimates without live traffic.

Use Android platform foreground-service/location APIs only during explicit active navigation, notification and stop action. Handle audio focus and offline voice using local OS TTS with optional user-selected engine; do not add a cloud TTS dependency.

Keep GPS traces on-device only if explicitly saved; no background tracking for browsing, no automatic external telemetry. Handle tunnel/poor GPS, route cancel, call interruption and permission revocation.
checks: Synthetic location replay in owned emulator: progress, wrong turn, GPS loss, reroute and stop releases resources.
Foreground service API-level rules, notification/permission failure, audio focus and no local TTS engine fallback.
phases.exit: Native guided navigation works offline, stops promptly and does not imply recording consent.
phases.commit: feat(maps): implement foreground navigation, rerouting and voice

phases.title: Finish the regional offline experience and update UX
phases.scope: Maps, references and prices keep distinct generations and lifetimes.
steps: Expose region download sizes/dependencies, Wi-Fi preference, pause/cancel/retry, storage controls and active-route safe deletion/update rules.

Activate a complete map generation only when engine and region dependencies match; keep last-good fallback and recover from process death. Overlay/reference/prices update separately and retain their dates.
Demonstrate offline browse/search/route/guidance/POI detail with downloaded data and no network endpoint contact. Missing regions or prices get explicit actions rather than false coverage.
checks: Airplane mode after clean restart, corrupted package, interrupted update, low storage and cross-region journey.
No stale price/live-status claim, no mixed native map generations and no file deletion while in use.
phases.exit: OFFLINE_GATE PASS covers the complete relevant journey, not only cached screenshots.
phases.commit: feat(maps): finish the regional offline experience and update ux

phases.title: Add private favorites, saved trips and safe file exchange
phases.scope: Useful CoMaps-inspired personal features, no mandatory tracking.
steps: Save stations and route plans locally with clear account/guest ownership. Reuse existing private backup/sync contracts and deny cross-account restore by default.

Implement needed KML/GPX import/export via a reviewed open-source parser or existing primitives; KMZ only with bounded archive handling. Keep original/source IDs and export license notices for public data.
Recording a trip is optional explicit opt-in, local by default, with stop/delete/export controls; no automatic recording during normal navigation and no public route upload.
checks: Malicious XML/XXE, oversized/recursive zip, traversal, point-count limits and malformed coordinates.
Account A/B/guest isolation, logout, stale restore, deleted trip resurrection, process restart and signed private backup cases.
phases.exit: Personal data is useful and portable without silently publishing home addresses or paths.
phases.commit: feat(maps): add private favorites, saved trips and safe file exchange

phases.title: Build the electric energy model as a pure domain component
phases.scope: Conservative configurable calculations with explicit assumptions.
steps: Use useful battery capacity, current SOC, desired reserve and consumption in exact units. Start with manual inputs/calibration from private sessions; PBE remains optional reference only after admission.

Calculate usable energy and segment consumption without claiming laboratory range as real range. Declared charger power is only an input bound; charging time depends on vehicle/curve/SOC and unknown components.

Define missing-data behavior and sensitivity inputs. Elevation can use admitted OSM/core/SRTM data later in this same scoped task if necessary; climate is not required and no noncommercial API is admitted.
checks: Boundary reserve/SOC/capacity, PHEV usable portion, units, rounding/overflow, negative distance/energy and missing-consumption cases.
Compare independent hand-calculated vectors and monotonic behavior; never count tests that duplicate implementation only.
phases.exit: A documented pure model returns interpretable estimates/unknowns, not guaranteed trip feasibility.
paths: backend/ (only if authoritative shared calculations are required)
phases.commit: feat(maps): build the electric energy model as a pure domain component

phases.title: Plan charging stops with a reachable alternative
phases.scope: Road-distance energy feasibility and explicit coverage gaps.
steps: Find compatible charging candidates along native road routes with bounded offline overlay/corridor data. Account for road detours, access/hours, useful power, tariff conditions and report recency.
Plan energy-constrained legs with reserve and charging stops. Test reachability of a fallback when the primary point fails; expose cases with no evidenced alternative instead of asserting safety.
Do not auto-route onto private/closed sites, merge incompatible connectors or optimize unknown prices as zero. Keep algorithm cancellation/limits so large queries cannot hang the phone or API.
checks: Single isolated charger, failed primary, unreachable alternate, nighttime closure, incompatible plug, unknown power/tariff, road closure uncertainty and offline missing corridor.
Deterministic route/energy integration vectors and bounded candidate explosion tests.
phases.exit: A plan explains primary/alternate reachability and assumptions; insufficient evidence is visible.
phases.commit: feat(maps): plan charging stops with a reachable alternative

phases.title: Expose trip planning and complete the electric private journey
phases.scope: Minimal themed screens over proven contracts.
steps: Add route inputs, vehicle/SOC/reserve/consumption, stop list, alternative details and estimated arrival charge with understandable assumptions. Preserve current profile visual conventions and shared borders.
Allow save/download and replan after a failed charger, maintaining provenance/recency offline. No promise that a trip cannot strand the user.

Finish charge history/cost/scenario execution and electric backup fields needed by the trip journey. Preserve ICE/free/PHEV accounting and existing entitlement rules; no new paid safety/contribution restriction.
checks: Server->Android price/scenario/private session actual flow, offline restart and two-account/two-device backup/restore when available.
TalkBack, 200% font, invalid inputs, low SOC, no map/no station and account switching.
phases.exit: The EV journey works from vehicle and map through plan, alternative, saved trip and private charge history.
phases.commit: feat(maps): expose trip planning and complete the electric private journey

phases.title: Measure performance, native compatibility and operational budgets
phases.scope: Measured constraints before broader geographic rollout.
steps: Measure cold/warm map load, frame pacing, native/Java memory, APK/ABI size, package/storage use, GPS battery impact, network bytes, spatial query latency and routing cancellation against the MAP-14 declared budgets.

Use representative low-resource device/emulator plus dense and sparse synthetic regions; define explicit budgets from product needs and measured MAP-14 baseline before acceptance, never after failures to declare green.

Bound map requests/clusters/caches/workers, verify source ingestion/backpressure and public package traffic. Build maps off the shared VPS unless its measured capacity supports the job; no live stress test without scoped authorization.
checks: Document hardware/OS/ABI/data/config/commit/commands and repeatable samples; required ABIs, minSdk and 16KB native page-size checks.
DB concurrency/load/failure, regional generation resource ceilings, leak/pause/resume and cancellation.
phases.exit: PERFORMANCE_GATE PASS has declared budgets and actual measurements; national capacity remains unclaimed.
phases.commit: feat(maps): measure performance, native compatibility and operational budgets

phases.title: Plan and validate optional in-car integration
phases.scope: Open-source client adapter; external vehicle-host acceptance separate.
steps: Assess AndroidX Car App Library license/dependency tree for the pinned version; no new closed-source map/navigation SDK or Google location dependency.

If admitted, implement a thin optional Android Auto client over the same local map/routes with host-safe controls, navigation intents and correct start/end metadata. Phone navigation must work without the host.

Car host/distribution rules, DHU/device availability and certification are external gates. If strict FOSS host requirements cannot be met, retain explicit EXTERNAL_PENDING/excluded platform obligation and do not block core phone features or claim this capability delivered.
checks: Navigation service/host lifecycle, stop request, reconnect and no driving-time text-entry regressions.
Owned DHU/head-unit evidence only when available/authorized; missing host is not a pass.
phases.exit: Optional in-car scope and its actual acceptance are explicit; no false parity or external certification claim.
phases.commit: feat(maps): plan and validate optional in-car integration

phases.title: Run regression, privacy and failure acceptance
phases.scope: Mandatory risk tests and final local source union.
steps: Prove isolation between public OSM references, public community and account-private routes/history. Review licensing obligations for actual derived databases; physical table separation alone is not a legal determination.
Exercise upgrades from actual prior Room/Postgres release, backup/restore/erasure, missing permissions, revoked account, stale source/manifests, source switch races and native failure recovery.

Preserve combustion ANP/community, free accounts/social participation, legacy IDs, existing UI/navigation and all critical security gates. Review dependencies/artifacts for secrets, private GPS and telemetry.
checks: Targeted security/money/privacy/SQL suites immediately, then the final appropriate Go/Rust/Kotlin/native union once.
Two-account/device/manual and rendered accessibility evidence explicit; missing external executions remain OWED.
phases.exit: All mandatory local contracts pass with exact artifacts and preserved regressions; evidence distinguishes local and external acceptance.
phases.commit: feat(maps): run regression, privacy and failure acceptance
phases.optional_predecessor: MAP-30 local disposition; external host proof is nonblocking for the phone

phases.title: Prepare scoped staging and manual acceptance runbooks
phases.scope: Reviewable deployment plan, not automatic production mutation.
steps: Produce version/source/license manifest, configs/defaults, migration/package compatibility, backup rehearsal, rollback plan and smoke checklist for teste.abastevo.com.br only when separately authorized.

Backend checks use synthetic records and bounded requests; no real contributor content or unsanctioned load campaign. Android manual steps are provided to the user unless device execution is explicitly authorized.

Check fuel/charging pins, exact source switch, detail/profile/routes, download/airplane restart, no GPS, neighbor maps, failed charger alternative and private restore. Production/G09/public pilot remain distinct.
checks: Local restore rehearsal and configuration validation; authorized staging results recorded only if actually executed.
Manual result sheet identifies device/build/region/source date; pending cases do not become PASS.
phases.exit: An operator/user can execute the runbook with explicit rollback and evidence; release stays uncertified until required real proofs.
phases.commit: docs(maps): prepare scoped staging and manual acceptance runbooks

phases.title: Deliver the cumulative protected batch and reconcile obligations
phases.scope: One final dev-to-main integration; no unrelated PR sweep.
steps: Freeze/reconcile the final source union, complete the phase/feature/license/acceptance matrix, include the engine source/SBOM/patch set/notices, inventory open PRs and prove required commits are included. Merge current main normally if needed; revalidate affected changes.

With explicit delivery authorization, push maintained dev and open/reuse one protected cumulative dev -> main PR. Inspect all applicable exact-head/base checks and reviews at finalization, fix failures in new commits, and preserve history.

Invoke scripts/git-flow.sh finish with the actual PR and required Quick verification only when guards pass. Missing/failed/skipped/cancelled required checks block merge; no force/admin bypass/direct-main push. Keep dev, verify ancestry and mirror allowed wiki pages once if authorized.
checks: git diff --check, secret-surface/dependency review, actual required CI current head/base and meaningful final acceptance evidence.
Record INTEGRATED/WIKI_PENDING and RELEASE_CERTIFIED separately; do not close incomplete issues or merge unrelated PRs merely because open.
phases.exit: Authorized source integration preserves every scoped commit and reports all remaining external/device/operator obligations honestly.
phases.commit: feat(maps): deliver the cumulative protected batch and reconcile obligations
